Subject: Staged launch plan draft — owners & target windows

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call earlier. As promised, please find the initial staged launch plan attached (staged-launch-plan-v1.xlsx). High level recap and asks below: 

Summary from discovery:
- Priority use case: contextual search + low-latency summarization for enterprise KB.
- Main blockers: procurement review, SOC 2 information, and internal integration validation window.
- Success metric for stage 1: sub-200ms mean latency at 20 qps for embed/search path; pilot adoption with 3 product teams.

Draft milestones (in the attached sheet):
1) POA & SOW signoff (procurement) — target windows: 2026-12-20 or 2027-01-31
2) Technical POC (integration + perf validation) — 3 weeks from kickoff
3) Pilot (product teams) — 4 weeks following POC success
4) Production rollout (phased) — 2–4 weeks after pilot

Proposed owners:
- Redwood technical lead: Ben Carter (own POC/benchmarks)
- Redwood CS/onboarding: Marissa Cole (pilot coordination)
- Stellarnet product: Liam O'Connor (product owner)
- Stellarnet procurement: Julie Park (procurement/terms)

Dependencies we flagged: SOC 2 evidence for storage/access, single-tenant VPC routing for the pilot, and an internal contact for federated auth.

Asks:
- Please confirm the internal Stellarnet stakeholders above (names + emails) or add anyone else who should be on the MAP.
- Which target window do you prefer for POA/SOW? (Dec 20, 2026 vs Jan 31, 2027)
- Any additional dependencies we missed?

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-minute MAP kickoff tomorrow or Wednesday to lock owners and the POC start date.

Attachments: staged-launch-plan-v1.xlsx (excel)

Thanks,
Rachel Kim

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the clear summary and the sheet. Quick answers inline: 

- Confirmed Stellarnet stakeholders: Liam O'Connor (Head of Product), Priya Menon (CTO), Julie Park (Sr. Procurement Manager, julie.park@stellarnet.io). I'll loop Priya into the SOC 2 thread once we have the evidence pack.
- Procurement prefers the Jan 31, 2027 window given internal Q4 freezes and our year-end budgeting.
- Dependencies: we will need our security team to run a short questionnaire (SOC 2 + encryption controls) and procurement wants an initial T&C redline before legal can commit.

Can Ben lead the POC timeline/benchmarks and share a quick test plan? Ben, can you confirm capacity to run the perf tests the week of Nov 8?

Also open to a kickoff call — Jan 4 seems late from our side; if we start POC in Nov we should sync next week to align.

Julie, any constraints from procurement on the Jan 31 vs Dec 20 windows beyond internal freezes? If Jan 31 is preferred we can align POC and pilot dates to match that close target.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to locking the roster and start date.
